name: trend_counter_trend_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Trend-following strategies on 1-min bars capture large intraday moves but give back significant profit at reversals because trailing stops lag. By using a trend-following entry (Supertrend-based) combined with a counter-trend exit (RSI divergence + VWAP distance extremes), the strategy captures the meat of the move while exiting before the trend exhausts. The inefficiency exists because most trend systems use symmetric trend-based exits; asymmetric entry/exit logic is less common in retail and requires more nuanced coding. Institutional algos focus on execution rather than directional signals at this frequency.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > ₹75 Cr; ATR(14) / close > 0.005 (sufficient intraday volatility)

indicators.name: RSI_Divergence
indicators.params: close makes new high but RSI(14) < RSI(14)[prior_high_bar]

long.confirmation: Entry bar closes in top 30% of its range: (close - low) / (high - low) > 0.7

short.confirmation: Entry bar closes in bottom 30% of its range: (close - low) / (high - low) < 0.3

entry.entry_price: market order on confirmation bar close

exit.trailing_stop: After 1.0 * ATR(14) profit, trail at 0.5 * ATR(14) from high-water mark
exit.signal_exit: Counter-trend exit: RSI bearish divergence (for longs) AND abs(VWAP_Distance_bps) > 60

filters.vix_filter: Widen stops to 1.5 * ATR(14) when India VIX > 22
filters.time_filter: No entries after 15:10 IST; no entries before 09:20
filters.event_filter: Avoid stock on result day; avoid all entries within 30 min of RBI policy

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — Supertrend is a well-known indicator but the counter-trend exit overlay is less common and provides defensiveness

weaknesses: Lower win rate (45%) means longer losing streaks; need psychological discipline and sufficient capital to survive 8-10 consecutive losses
RSI divergence detection on 1-min bars is inherently noisy — false divergences are common and may trigger premature exits, cutting winners short
Supertrend(10, 3.0) on 1-min bars can whipsaw during the first hour when volatility is highest, generating false entries
prior_art: Supertrend indicator by Olivier Seban; RSI divergence widely used in technical analysis; asymmetric entry/exit discussed in Kaufman's 'Trading Systems and Methods'
notes: Consider adding a minimum holding period of 10 bars before counter-trend exit can trigger, to avoid premature exits. ATR-based stops auto-adapt to volatility, reducing need for manual parameter tuning on VIX changes.
